rows.title: The Crude Demagogy of “Don’t Look Up”
rows.dek_lead: Adam McKay’s satire “Don’t Look Up” is a clever film that’s short on wit. The difference is that wit is multifaceted, like a gem that, however small, offers different glimmers at different angles.
